up: Retrieve exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614481, along with their compound ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES structures. Filter activities to only include exact values where standard_relation = '='. Join activities with assays on assay_id, filter by assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614481'. Join compound_structures to get canonical_smiles, and molecule_dictionary to get chembl_id. Return columns: standard_value, standard_units, standard_relation, chembl_id, canonical_smiles. Do not apply row limits. Do not filter by confidence_score or other unrequested criteria.
sql: SELECT a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_relation, md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614481' AND a.standard_relation = '='
